id: title:Piccirello:allow data url fonts and drop an unused cdn origin

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the Content-Security-Policy header returned by the middleware, potentially allowing the browser to load fonts from a data: URL alongside the previously listed static hosts.
review.reason: Replaced the font-src CSP value with a literal string including 'data:', retaining original allowed hosts. This is a narrow, localized maintenance change to the CSP middleware configuration.
review.uncertainty: The exact operational impact depends on whether this middleware is actively used to generate CSP for requests involving the specified static hosts; no execution or request-response evidence is provided.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single hunk. No other hunks are supplied, so no relationship between PRs can be established. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced the font-src CSP value, adding the literal string 'data:' while retaining the original allowed hosts. Added a comment explaining that data: URLs do not execute script and do not carry tokens, distinguishing this from worker-src restrictions.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the Content-Security-Policy header returned by the middleware, potentially allowing the browser to load fonts from a data: URL alongside the previously listed static hosts. This could affect the loading behavior of font resources served by PostHog, depending on whether the middleware is used to generate the CSP for requests to app-static hosts or if this middleware is used,
